periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented, slanting upwards at approximately 45 degrees from the snout toward the ears.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovoid morphology with a vertical major axis; height-to-width ratio is approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: The lower portion of the patch tapers into a teardrop shape, extending significantly below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band occupying roughly 35% of the visible lateral shoulder height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide horizontal separation approximately equal to the width of the frontal bone region.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded curvature across the superior margins of both pinnae.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of bamboo stalks held in both the mouth and the forelimbs.
